newsitem.title: USA: Microlog wins $20 mln university contract.
newsitem.headline: Microlog wins $20 mln university contract.

text.p: Microlog Corp said Tuesday that its Old Dominion Systems Inc of Maryland subsidiary has won a contract renewal with The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory that it estimates is worth as much as $20 million over three years.
The company said that the contract renewal is a coninuation of one under which it has provided software, analytical, administrative services, and hardware support to the laboratory since 1992.

Microlog designs, develops, markets, and supports interactive communications systems and application solutions. Its Old Dominion unit provides technical and administrative support to US prime government contractors.
